hooks.command: cmd=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write((JSON.parse(d).tool_input||{}).command||'')}catch(e){}})"); is_commit=0; is_push=0; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)' && is_commit=1; printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]|$)' && is_push=1; if [ $is_commit -eq 1 ] || [ $is_push -eq 1 ]; then out=$(bash scripts/check-secrets.sh staged 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; if [ $is_push -eq 1 ]; then up=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1); out=$(bash scripts/check-secrets.sh range "$up..HEAD" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0
